findings.claim: «Enviar equipa» (the E key or button on a landed-UFO or terror-site popup, card or list row) opens the craft dialog with the interceptors listed first and the first one focused. The usual reflex E → Enter therefore launches Intercetor-1, which carries no soldiers, to the ground target. The Skyranger is listed last. craftsFor() (geo_ui.js:218-233) sorts only by ok and then ETA. World.canOrder accepts interceptors for ground targets, and they are always faster, so they always come first. The dialog also keeps the interception wording («INTERCEÇÃO · Que nave envia contra OVNI-1?»).
findings.evidence: Playwright script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/p17_send.mjs, 1280×800 @2x. Fresh campaign, landed UFO in France, detected by the radar, popup «OVNI detetado» with buttons [Enviar equipa E, Centrar C, OK ↵]. Pressing E opens the dialog with rows [Intercetor-1 18 min, Intercetor-2 18 min, Skyranger-1 49 min · 8/10 soldados], and focus is on Intercetor-1. Pressing Enter gives G.crafts = c2:interceptor:out:{kind:'ufo',id:'u1'} and c1:skyranger:ready. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/out/send_team_dialog.png. The interceptor arrives and gets no «Iniciar missão» (World.js:355: prompt 'mission' only for a transport with fit soldiers).
findings.fix: In craftsFor(G, baseId, target), when the target is a ground target (site, alienBase, or a UFO with status landed or crashed), sort transports with fitSoldiers > 0 first (then by ETA). Put non-transport crafts after them and dim them, with a note such as «não leva soldados». When the dialog is opened from sendBtn, use a send-team title and kicker (e.g. «Enviar equipa · Que nave leva a equipa a OVNI-1?») and focus the first transport. Add a geoui_model test: a landed UFO with 2 interceptors and 1 Skyranger must give the Skyranger at index 0.

findings.claim: While an interception is minimised (M or Esc), the visible Geoscape says time is running when it is not, and its keyboard is dead. The run dot stays «on» (pulsing), the button reads «Pausa» and the speed 3 button stays lit, but the clock is frozen. The lists are stale, because only the top scene thinks. Esc does nothing, so it cannot restore the panel. B/U/F/S/I/1–6 are swallowed, yet the same Geoscape buttons still respond to the mouse. The player sees a running world that does not move and does not answer the keyboard.
findings.evidence: Script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/p10_dfmin.mjs (1280×800). Launch Intercetor-1 at the UFO and wait for the dogfight, then press M. Panel at t0: {t:2180, clock:'12:36', run:'geo-run on', pauseLbl:'Pausa', speed index 2 checked}. Panel 3 s later: identical (t still 2180). Keys while minimised: Escape → stack [geoscape, dogfight], still minimised. 5/b/u/f/s/i → no scene change. Clicking the «1 dia» speed button with the mouse does change the selection. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/out/df_min_1280.png. Cause: Scenes.think only runs the top scene (scenes.js), and DogfightUI.onInput forwards only CAMERA_KEYS when nothing is focused (dogfight_ui.js:1542-1553).
findings.fix: In DogfightUI.onInput with no focused panel: Esc restores the most recent panel. Forward the Geoscape keys (B/U/F/S/1–6) to the scene below, or answer them with a short toast «Interceção em curso — M para abrir». In GeoUI.pause(), when the top scene is 'dogfight', switch the run dot off and show the existing .geo-banner with «Tempo parado: interceção em curso». Alternatively, let DogfightUI.think call the Geoscape's refresh (refreshTime/refreshLists) every 220 ms so the panel stays truthful.

findings.claim: Holding Esc slightly too long cascades through several stacked screens, because only the modals and the Geoscape ignore auto-repeat. From Equipar inside a mission briefing, held Esc closes Equipar and then cancels the briefing (C.cancelMission). Re-launching takes a new map seed. From a Basescape sheet or the Ufopédia opened from the base, held Esc throws the player out to the Geoscape. makeScreen.onInput (screens.js:518-523), the BaseUI onKey (base_ui.js:1735, the Esc branch runs before the `if (ev.repeat)` check at 1748) and the base sheet onKey (base_ui.js:1538) all act on repeat events.
findings.evidence: Script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/p13_brief.mjs. Skyranger arrives at a landed UFO → Enter → [geoscape, cbriefing] → E → [geoscape, cbriefing, equip]. Escape held for 1 keydown + 3 repeats (about 120 ms): stack [geoscape], G.activeMission = null. Script p18_escrep.mjs: Basescape research tab, N (sheet open), Esc held for 1 + 2 repeats: stack goes from [geoscape, basescape] to [geoscape]. Base → U: [geoscape, basescape, ufopaedia] → held Esc → [geoscape]. GeoUI already guards this (`if (ev.repeat && …) return true`) and so does OV.Dom.modal.
findings.fix: Ignore Escape (and Enter) events with ev.repeat / e.repeat in makeScreen.onInput, in the BaseUI onKey (move the repeat check above the Esc branch), in the base sheet's onKey and in the Ufopédia and inventory key handlers. Only a fresh key press should leave a screen. A Playwright regression could press Escape with repeats and assert that only one level was popped.

findings.claim: The most-used Geoscape button and the popup action use the Brazilian / pre-AO90 spelling «Interceptar». Everything else in the game uses pt-PT AO90: «Intercetor-1», «INTERCEÇÃO», «interceta», «intercetam», «Intercetores abatem OVNIs», «OVNIS DETETADOS».
findings.evidence: pt-PT.geoui.js:27 'geo.btn.intercept': 'Interceptar' and :135 'geo.a.intercept': 'Interceptar'. Grep: these two are the only 'intercept*' forms in js/i18n. The others are intercetor/intercetores/interceta/intercetam/intercetar and interceção. Visible next to «INTERCEÇÃO» and «Intercetor-1» in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/out/c_1280x800_intercept.png. The geo_ui.js:18 header comment says «I interceptar» too.
findings.fix: Change both strings to 'Intercetar'. Add a check to tools/tests/campaign_ui_texts.test.js (or a new i18n test) that fails on /intercep/i, /detect/i and /\bac[çc]ão/ in the OV.STR values.

findings.claim: The new-campaign base-placement panel shows coordinates with a decimal point («40.0° N · 8.6° O»). The Geoscape shows the same data with the pt-PT decimal comma (geo.ll with dec1 → «38,7° N»), and so does every other number in the strategy layer («64,5/100»).
findings.evidence: campaign_ui.js:353: fmtLL uses Math.abs(p.lat).toFixed(1) directly. The innerText of the placement panel captured by /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/p12_newgame.mjs reads «COORDENADAS 40.0° N · 8.6° O». Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/out/ng3_chosen_1280.png. GeoUI's fmtLL (geo_ui.js:46-51) uses dec1 with .replace('.', ',').
findings.fix: Use .toFixed(1).replace('.', ',') in campaign_ui.js fmtLL, or better, reuse OV.GeoUI.model's lat/lon formatter (geo.ll), so the new-game screen and the Geoscape share one format.

findings.claim: In the Geoscape interception / send-team dialog, the arrow keys rotate the globe behind the dialog instead of moving between the craft rows. Only Tab moves the focus. The save/load dialog in the same flow uses ↑/↓ to pick a row, so the keyboard language is inconsistent, and a Mac player who presses ↓ to pick the second craft sees the world spin.
findings.evidence: Script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/p16_dlgkeys.mjs. I → focus on «Skyranger-1» row, lon −9.1. ArrowDown: focus unchanged. ArrowRight: lon −9.1 → 2.9 (globe rotated), focus unchanged. Tab: focus → «Intercetor-1». Cause: onKey (geo_ui.js:1951+) handles CAMERA_KEYS before the S.dlg branch.
findings.fix: In onKey, when S.dlg is open and the focus is inside it, let ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the focus between the dialog's row buttons (wrap around), with Enter choosing the row. Keep the arrows as camera keys only when no dialog or popup has focus.

findings.claim: On iPad (touch), the Basescape and new-campaign hints still give mouse and keyboard instructions: «Clique numa instalação…; duplo clique…», «Clique e escolha o sítio na grelha (Shift+clique constrói sem confirmar)», «Clique em terra firme…». The Geoscape already switches to a touch variant (geo.hint.touch when OV.Input.lastPointerType === 'touch').
findings.evidence: iPad emulation (1180×820, hasTouch) via /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/p2_crawl.mjs 1180 820 touch. Basescape screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/out/c_1180x820t_base6.png shows «Clique numa instalação para ver os detalhes; duplo clique abre o separador respetivo.» Keys involved: base.info.idleHint, base.build.clickToPlace (Shift+click is impossible on touch), base.build.validHere, base.crafts.crewHint, base.equip.hint, cp.ng.help. Touch itself works (p7_touch.mjs: tap selects, double-tap jumps to the tab, tap on a cell during a build gives the confirm or deny).
findings.fix: Add '.touch' variants of these keys («Toque numa instalação…; toque duplo abre…», «Toque no sítio da grelha para construir») and pick them as GeoUI does, using OV.Input.lastPointerType === 'touch'. Drop the Shift+clique sentence on touch.

findings.claim: On iPad portrait (820×1180), Geoscape toasts are centred on the whole viewport rather than on the globe area, so they slide under or over the side panel's «GEOSCAPE» kicker and date. At 1180 and 1280 widths the same toasts clear the panel.
findings.evidence: Script /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/mac-ux/p15_toast.mjs, toast «Intercetor-1 regressou à base (Base Lusitânia).». At 820×1180: toast box [239,10 → 581,41], side panel from x=554, 825 px² overlap. At 1180×820 and 1280×800: 0 overlap. The same clash is visible in the other reviewer's /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/review4/bugs/out/t9-geo-popup-820x1180.png (toast covers «GEOSCAPE»).
findings.fix: While the Geoscape is mounted, offset #toasts by the globe area: GeoUI already writes --geo-side on its root, so set a body class (e.g. body.geo-on #toasts { left: 0; right: var(--geo-side); }) or move the toast stack below the tools column. Alternatively cap the toast max-width at calc(100vw - var(--geo-side) - 32px).

findings.claim: The campaign still cannot be won from the UI: no screen launches the Cydonia mission. When «Cidónia ou Desastre» completes, the base research tab says «A missão final está disponível: envie o Vingador para Cidónia.», but the player has nowhere to send it. The sim side is ready: Campaign.startMission accepts {kind:'cydonia'}. Nothing in the UI calls CampaignUI.launchMission(G,{kind:'cydonia'},craftId). An earlier review (wave4_findings_ui_A) reported this and it is still open.
findings.evidence:
Script review4/diversao/s3_cydonia.mjs (Playwright, real UI) sets G.researched to include cydonia and G.flags.cydoniaUnlocked=true, and puts a ready Avenger 'Vingador-1' in the hangar.
- Geoscape «Interceptar» → Vingador-1 shows «Nenhum alvo conhecido. Escolha um ponto no globo para patrulhar.» There is no Cydonia target.
- Base → Naves → Vingador-1 offers only weapons, crew and «Equipar».
- Base → Investigação shows the hint «A missão final está disponível: envie o Vingador para Cidónia.»
- No button in the whole DOM matches /cid|marte|final/.
- Code: targetsFor() (geo_ui.js ~l.234) only lists UFOs, sites and discovered alien bases. grep finds no launchMission(…{kind:'cydonia'}) call anywhere under js/ui.
- Effect: the victory screen, which looks good, is reachable only through the debug entry OV.CampaignUI.victory.
findings.fix:
Cheap and high impact.
- In targetsFor(G, craftId), when G.flags.cydoniaUnlocked is set and the craft is an Avenger (or a spacecraft) in the hangar with status 'ready', append a pseudo-target {ref:{kind:'cydonia'}, ok:true}. Label it «Cidónia (Marte) — missão final».
- Picking it opens a confirm modal («Partir para Marte? Não há regresso se falhar»), then calls OV.CampaignUI.launchMission(G,{kind:'cydonia'},craftId), which already goes to the briefing.
- Also add a primary «Lançar assalto a Cidónia» button on the Avenger card in Base → Naves, and on the researchDone popup for 'cydonia'.
- Add a QA step to qa/full_campaign.mjs that reaches the victory screen through this button, not through the debug entry.

findings.claim: A new player usually loses the first UFO. The interception window opens in «Distância» (no fire), and the UFO's escape countdown starts at the same moment. On Veterano a Small Scout's countdown is 140–340 ticks (4–10 s). Anyone who takes a few seconds to read the new window watches the UFO escape. The escape message («Perdeu-se o contacto») gives no reason. Separately, the default Stingray turns a «Muito pequeno» UFO into debris about 60 % of the time, so there is no crash site, and nothing on screen says so.
findings.evidence:
Real UI (s2_dogfight.mjs: Veterano, first detected UFO, «Interceptar» → Intercetor-1):
- No input: seeds 1, 3, 4 and 5 all ended «OVNI escapou», at 9.8 / 9.1 / 6.6 / 10.1 s after the window opened.
- Pressing 3 (Normal) after 2 s: seed 1 crashed, seed 3 crashed, seeds 4 and 5 destroyed.
- Pressing 3 after 4 s: seeds 1 and 4 escaped, seed 3 crashed, seed 5 destroyed.

Headless check (a3b_delay.js, 200 seeds each): escape rate on Veterano by reaction delay.

| UFO | Mode | 0 s | 2 s | 3 s | 4 s | 6 s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small scout | Normal | 6 % | 30 % | 42 % | 62 % | 90 % |
| Medium scout | Normal | 11 % | 28 % | 40 % | 51 % | 80 % |

With all weapons on (a3_dogfight.js), a Small Scout ends destroyed 119/200 and crashed only 71/200. Cannon only: 100 escaped / 100 crashed.

The status line at open reads «Distância segura. Escolha Cauteloso, Normal ou Agressivo (2–4) para atacar.» It gives no sense of urgency.
findings.fix:
Cheap and high impact. Respect the reading time (DESIGN pillar 6) without changing the rules.
- Open the dogfight paused (S.paused=true with a quiet pause). Show the banner «Escolha a postura para começar (2–4)». The first mode key or click resumes the dogfight.
- Alternative: open in 'standard' when the craft is armed.
- df.sub.escaped: add «Escolha logo a postura de ataque: em Distância o OVNI ganha tempo para fugir.»
- When the UFO is size 0 and Stingray/Avalanche are fitted, show the chip «Mísseis podem desintegrá-lo — desligue-os (Q) para abater só com o canhão e recuperar os destroços».
- Optionally apply the playtest's data patch small_scout.breakOff 200→360 so that cannon-only is viable.

findings.claim: The first terror site is not fair to a new player. It arrives on days 5–10 of January, often at night and often before the first ordinary battle. On Veterano the starting 8 rookies win it only about half the time and lose 5–6 soldiers. Leaving it unanswered costs −1 000 points, which alone makes January «Terrível» and starts the countdown to shutdown. DESIGN §14 schedules the first terror in the escalation phase (from Jan 20), after a tutorial-like scout crash.
findings.evidence:
Bot timelines (a1_timeline.js, Veterano, 12 seeds × 60 days):
- First terror on days 4.8–10.5 (median 6.6) in every seed; 6 of 11 fought were at night.
- Month-0 terror: 8 of 11 won, 3 squad wipes (10/10 dead).

`tools/sim.js battle --kind terror --diff 1 --month 0`, 24 seeds per row:

| Squad | Light | Wins | Soldiers lost per battle |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | day | 46 % | 5.25 |
| 8 | night | 54 % | 6.04 |
| 10 | day | 83 % | 5.13 |
| 10 | night | 54 % | 6.96 |

The tool's own target is 70 % wins and ≤ 3 losses.

UI run of qa/full_campaign.mjs (seed 314):
- Terror at Vancouver on 6 Jan, 11 h to respond.
- It expired, and the January report read «TERRÍVEL −1 076», «um segundo mês assim encerra o projeto».

Knob test (a2_variant.js, FT_DELAY=14400, i.e. firstTerror startDelay 3 d → 10 d, same 12 seeds):
- First terror median moves to day 13.8.
- Month-0 terror wins go from 8/11 to 10/12.
- Median January rating goes from 216 to 524.
- In no seed is the first battle a terror site (1 seed before the change).
findings.fix:
Cheap data changes.
- In js/data/geo.js set firstTerror.startDelay from 3*24*60 to 10*24*60. This puts the first terror at about day 13–17, after the scout crashes, as DESIGN §14 intends.
- Also either start with 10 soldiers on Recruta/Veterano (the Skyranger UI seats 10; 8→10 lifts day terror from 46 % to 83 %), or add to the intro and the terror popup: «Skyranger-1 leva 8 de 10 soldados — contrate mais no Pessoal (tecla 4), chegam em 48 h».
- Re-run campaign_pacing.test.js afterwards.

findings.claim: The Geoscape never reminds the player that all scientists and engineers are idle. A parent who closes the welcome popup and presses «1 dia» can lose weeks of research. The «!» badges and the idle warnings exist only inside the base screen.
findings.evidence:
s4_idle.mjs (real UI, Veterano seed 21): close the intro with Enter, press 6, and click OK on every popup.
- After 12.5 game days: G.bases[0].research.length = 0, BaseSim.staff free scientists 10, engineers 10, researched [].
- Popups seen in that time: ufoDetected ×4, ufoLanded ×3, terrorSite, terrorSiteExpired. None of them mentions the idle staff.
- The «Bases B» button has no badge: no element matching [class*=badge] in .geo-acts.
- base_ui.js l.405 does compute the idle-scientist badge, but only for the base tabs. The only Geoscape mention of idle staff is inside the researchDone popup (geo_ui.js l.1470), which never fires if nothing was started.
findings.fix:
Cheap and high impact.
- Show a warn badge «!» on the Geoscape «Bases» button with the tip «10 cientistas sem projeto · 10 engenheiros sem trabalho». Reuse the same rule as BaseUI's tab badges, computed from OV.BaseSim.staff(G, b.id) and C().availableResearch.
- Add a one-shot popup on the first day tick when no research has started yet: «Os cientistas estão parados — abra a base (B) e escolha um projeto», with an «Ir para a base» button.

findings.claim: After «Lançar» the clock stays at «5 seg», so the chase to the first UFO takes 25–40 s of real time with nothing to do. The intro mentions keys 1–6, but nothing at that moment suggests speeding up. The same happens after «Enviar equipa».
findings.evidence:
Script s2b.mjs, real UI, no key pressed after launch.
- Right after the click, GeoUI.current() reports {speed:0, paused:false}.
- The dogfight opened 37.4 s later (seed 3) and 24.2 s later (seed 4); the chases lasted 28 and 25 game minutes.
- At «5 seg» one 80 ms step is 5 game seconds, so a 35-min chase costs about 34 s. At «1 min» it is about 2.8 s.
findings.fix:
Cheap.
- When an intercept or transport order is accepted while speed index is 0, set the speed to index 1 («1 min»). The contact and arrival popups still stop the clock as they do now.
- Alternatively, show a toast «Nave a caminho — acelere o tempo (2–3)».

findings.claim:
The monthly report cannot be read correctly, which matters because it is the moment the council threatens to end the game.
- The funding table footer puts last month's income ($6 000 000) under the «Agora» column, although the «Agora» rows add up to about $800 k less. Next month's income is shown nowhere.
- «Atividade alienígena −1 086» is a single bar. A new player cannot tell that −1 000 of it is the one terror site they ignored.
findings.evidence:
Screenshot fc314/029_month_report.png (January, seed 314, Veterano).
- The «Antes» column adds up to $6 000 000; the «Agora» column adds up to $5 203 000.
- The tfoot row still shows $6 000 000 in the «Agora» column.
- Code at campaign_ui.js ~l.1076: tfoot = [label, empty, empty, money(R.income)]. R.income is the funding paid for the month that just ended (economy.js monthEnd: inc = Σ c.funding before the change).
- The score section has only three bars: Atividade X-COM 0, Investigação +10, Atividade alienígena −1 086. The −1 000 came from «Ataque sem resposta» in Vancouver.
findings.fix:
Cheap.
- Make the tfoot show Σbefore | Σdelta | Σafter, with the label «Receita do próximo mês» on the after total.
- Split the alien score.
  - UI-only option: report G.stats.terrorIgnored for this month (stash the counter at month start in G.ui), as «Ataques terroristas sem resposta ×1: −1 000», plus «Atividade de OVNIs e bases: −86».
  - Sim option: Economy.addScore takes a cause tag and the report carries alienCauses {terrorIgnored, ufoActivity, missions, alienBases}.
- When badMonths === 1, also give the advice «Responda aos ataques terroristas e abata OVNIs para subir a avaliação».

findings.claim: After a won crash mission the debrief and the Geoscape do not say that new research has opened. The recovered loot opens 5 research topics silently, so the rewarding «what next» moment is missed.
findings.evidence:
- Node check: newCampaign Veterano, availableResearch is [laser_weapons, medikit, motion_scanner].
- After adding the loot from the UI run's first debrief (fc314/044: 4 alloys, alien grenade, 5 Floater corpses, plasma pistols and rifle with clips), these become available: alien_alloys, plasma_pistol, plasma_rifle, alien_grenade, autopsy_floater.
- The debrief (campaign_ui.js ~l.880–982) has no line about research.
- The fc314 log shows no popup on return to the Geoscape.
findings.fix:
Cheap.
- In afterBattle, diff C().availableResearch(G, baseId) before and after finishMission.
- In the debrief add a section «Novos projetos de investigação: Ligas Alienígenas, Pistola de Plasma, …» with a button «Abrir investigação» (BaseUI.open(G, baseId, 'research')).

findings.claim: The «OVNI aterrou» and «OVNI abatido» popups do not say whether the Skyranger can get there in time, or whether it will be night on arrival. The terror popup already gives the ETA. Night matters here: the player sees 9 tiles against the aliens' 20, and night terror wins drop from 83 % to 54 % with 10 soldiers.
findings.evidence:
- geo_ui.js l.1375–1396: the ufoLanded and ufoCrashed popups have rows and buttons but no `lines`. The terrorSite popup (l.1512) adds terrorEtaLine(ref, s).
- Screenshot fc314/027_popup_ufoLanded.png shows only Estado, Tipo, Tamanho, Altitude and Local.
- In the same run the landed UFOs took off within 11–17 h. The player had no way to judge whether to send the team.
findings.fix:
Cheap.
- Reuse terrorEtaLine for ufoLanded and ufoCrashed: «Skyranger-1 chega em 2 h 10 min».
- Add the light at arrival («— lá será noite»), computed from the same phase used by Campaign.briefingMeta.
- For crashed UFOs, compare the ETA with crashLeftS.

findings.claim:
With today's code a Veterano campaign rarely reaches a satisfying ending, and the results in CAMPAIGN_API §11.4 are now stale.
- Out of 16 bot campaigns, 3 were won, 5 were lost at Cydonia (3 wins in 8 attempts), and 7 had no ending by day 200–240.
- In several runs the Avenger is starved of alloys long after Cydonia research is done.
- From month 4 on, terror sites are near-certain squad wipes.
findings.evidence:
- Runs: `node tools/sim.js campaign --seeds 10 --seed0 1 --diff 1 --days 240 --json` and seeds 101–106 at 200 days (out/vet10.json, out/vet6.json).
- Endings: {victory 3, cydonia 5, timeout 7, council 1}. Victories on days 121.5, 144.5 and 151.5.
- §11.4 states 40 % victories and a 67 % Cydonia win rate.
- Terror sites by month, as [fought, won, soldiers lost]:
  - m0 [15, 11, 70]
  - m1 [16, 16, 41]
  - m2 [10, 5, 70]
  - m3 [11, 8, 67]
  - m4+ [21, 3, 202]
- Seed 9 (a4_avenger.js): Cydonia researched on day 114.5, funds $9–13 M. Stores stay at alloys 16/40, power sources 3, navigation 2 from day 90 to day 225; production is empty and no Avenger is built.
- Seeds 104 and 105 also research Cydonia (days 114.5 and 103.5) and have no Avenger by day 200.
findings.fix:
Re-run and refresh §11.4 and DESIGN §14 with the current code.
- Make the bot hunt crash sites while the Avenger is waiting on alloys (it sits idle with $12 M).
- Consider data knobs:
  - Avenger materials 40 → 25 alloys (manufacture.avenger), the main ending gate for a human too;
  - cap terror crews for months 4+ (Snakeman / Muton).
- On Cydonia defeat, offer «Carregar a última gravação automática» as a button, next to the existing «L» hint on the game-over screen, so a family can retry the finale.

findings.claim: Late January is dead time: in most seeds no UFO is detected and no battle happens from about day 12 to about day 32. After the opening burst (gameStart scouts and firstTerror), month 0 has no further missions. DESIGN §14 expects 4–6 battles from Jan 20 to March.
findings.evidence:
- a1_timeline.js, Veterano, 12 seeds: the longest stretch with neither a detected UFO nor a battle has a median of 20 days (max 24.6), starting around day 11–15.
- 10 of 12 seeds have at most one detection between days 15 and 31.
- Moving only firstTerror to day 10 (FT_DELAY=14400) leaves the gap at 20.2 days.
- Also running the 'recon' table script in month 0 with startDelay 14 d (RECON0=20160) cuts it to 15.2 days and raises month-0 battles to a median of 5.
- At «1 dia» the gap is only about 8 s of real time, and research popups land in it, so the impact is moderate.
findings.fix:
Data only.
- Add a month-0 table mission (recon: firstMonth 0, startDelay about 14 d), or a second gameStart-like alien_research script around day 15. This puts a scout or two into late January.
- Combine with the firstTerror delay above, so the terror site falls in the same window and does not land in week 1.

findings.claim:
Some player-facing texts are inconsistent or unclear.
- The main button and action say «Interceptar» (pre-AO90 spelling), while the rest of the game uses «Interceção / Intercetor / intercetar».
- geo.end.cydonia and geo.end.victory.body say «Cydonia»; everything else says «Cidónia».
- The research picker writes «Desbloqueia: Kit Médico» for the medikit topic, which mixes research topics with manufacture, so it reads as a tautology («I already have Kit Médicos»).
findings.evidence:
- grep of js/i18n: 'geo.btn.intercept': 'Interceptar' and 'geo.a.intercept': 'Interceptar', against 'geo.int.kicker': 'Interceção', 'Intercetores' in the intro, and the dogfight 'interceção'.
- 'geo.end.cydonia': '…Cydonia…' against 'research.cydonia': 'Cidónia ou Desastre'.
- base_ui.js l.751 joins topic, manufacture and facility names under one 'base.research.unlocks' label.
- Screenshot fc314/008: «Kit Médico — Desbloqueia: Kit Médico», «Detetor de Movimento — Desbloqueia: Detetor de Movimento».
findings.fix:
Cheap text changes.
- «Intercetar» in geo.btn.intercept and geo.a.intercept.
- «Cidónia» in both geo.end strings.
- In the picker, label manufacture leads «fabrico de X» and facility leads «construção de X». Example: «Desbloqueia: fabrico de Kit Médico».
